cards.public_summary: Jalen Hurts threw two interceptions in practice, including a Riq Woolen pick-six on an out route intended for DeVonta Smith.
cards.evidence:
Riq Woolen just picked off Jalen Hurts for a second time tonight, this time a pick-6 after jumping an out route to DeVonta Smith.

It's been an up-and-down from Hurts. A few big plays downfield but two picks on poorly placed passes. #Eagles
cards.commentary: This is a negative practice-performance note for Hurts, but the report also cites downfield big plays and does not establish a lasting issue.
